title: Hooks
description: Low-level hooks behind ConfigProvider: manage the theme, the language and lib-core's translations yourself.

reference.title: Reference
reference.text: All hooks and utilities are exported from @minerva/lib-core.
reference.useAutoTheme: Keeps the active theme in state and, outside of a ConfigProvider, writes it as CSS variables on <html>. With "auto" or a { light, dark } pair it subscribes to prefers-color-scheme and unsubscribes on unmount. Returns the configured theme, its setter and the current system scheme. Inside a ConfigProvider it only manages the state: the root provider owns <html>.
reference.useLocale: Keeps the locale in state and, outside of a ConfigProvider, switches the language of lib-core's built-in texts (en, zh, ja or fr). Returns the locale and its setter. Inside a ConfigProvider it only manages the state: the root provider owns the global language.
reference.useI18n: Returns t, the language it translates to and the i18next instance used by lib-core. t follows the locale of the closest nested ConfigProvider that sets one, otherwise lib-core's global language. It is a private instance, so your application's own i18next setup is never affected.
reference.useDisclosure: Open / closed state for overlays (Modal, Drawer, Popover...), controlled (isOpen + onChange) or uncontrolled (defaultIsOpen). Returns isOpen and stable onOpen, onClose and onToggle callbacks.
reference.useDialogFocusReturn: Focus return for dialogs opened from state, without a Radix Trigger. Remembers the element focused before opening and focuses it again after closing. Pass open, contentRef and onCloseAutoFocus to the dialog.
reference.cn: Joins class names and skips falsy values (false, null, undefined, 0, empty strings). A tiny, dependency-free alternative to classnames for conditional classes.
reference.global: useAutoTheme and useLocale only change global state (CSS variables on <html>, lib-core's language) when no ConfigProvider is above them. This site has one at the root, so the demos below pass the hook state to a nested ConfigProvider, which applies it to the preview only.

standalone.title: Using the hooks without ConfigProvider
standalone.text: If you don't need useConfig(), you can call useAutoTheme and useLocale directly, instead of a provider. Inside a provider they only hold state: pass it to a nested ConfigProvider to apply it to a subtree.

focusReturn.title: Returning focus after a dialog
focusReturn.text: Radix dialogs restore focus to their Trigger when they close. A dialog opened from state (a menu item, a keyboard shortcut, a table row) has no Trigger, so focus would fall back to <body>. useDialogFocusReturn records the element focused before opening and restores it on close:

use-auto-theme.title: useAutoTheme
use-auto-theme.description: setTheme changes the theme of the preview, applied by a nested ConfigProvider; systemTheme always reports the operating system scheme. The rest of the page keeps the site's theme.

use-locale.title: useLocale and useI18n
use-locale.description: setLocale changes the locale passed to a nested ConfigProvider; t() from useI18n returns lib-core's built-in texts in that language.

use-disclosure.title: useDisclosure and cn
use-disclosure.description: useDisclosure drives a panel with onToggle, onOpen and onClose; cn builds its class name from conditional parts.
